articles.title_en: Russian strikes hit two Kyiv gas stations, one of them twice. Several killed and injured, including rescue worker.
articles.lead_en: Russian forces struck two gas stations in Kyiv, one in the Dniprovskyi district and one in the Obolonskyi district, Mayor Vitali Klitschko said.
